messages.text: An Bs-2 ordernumber: Shop···· it is flashing red

I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed me the flashing red light on your BS-2.

Red on the BS-2 almost always means it is not connected or not hashing, and that is often a setting rather than a dead board. One thing first so I point you the right way:

1. Plug the unit in and let it sit for about 2 minutes.
2. Tell me what the red LED does: a slow steady blink, a fast blink, or solid red?

Also, is it connected by Wi-Fi or Ethernet, and does the unit show up in your router or in the web UI at all?
The pump is flash red and sounds strange plugged it out for 6 hours and no change

Thanks, that detail helps. A red pump light plus an odd noise is usually either air trapped in the loop or the pump itself not turning properly. Let us rule out the air first, it is the common one and it is free to fix.

With the unit unplugged:

1. Tilt it gently left and right, then front to back, about 10 times. You are trying to move a trapped air bubble out of the pump head.
2. Set it back down level, on a hard flat surface, not on carpet.
3. Plug it in and listen for the first 2 minutes.

Tell me what you get:

- Noise gone and light turns green or blue: it was air, you are done.
- Still red and noisy: that points at the pump.

One more thing that will speed this up either way: a short video, 10 to 15 seconds, with sound, showing the light and the noise, and a clear photo of the serial label on the back. Send both here.
Slow flashing  and ticking sound still

That is the answer I did not want. A slow red flash with a ticking pump, after the air purge and a 6 hour cold rest, means the pump is trying to start and stalling. That is mechanical, not a setting, and there is nothing safe left for you to try at home. Do not open the unit or the loop, that would void the warranty.

Two things so I can hand this on properly:

1. A short video, 10 to 15 seconds, with sound, showing the slow red flash and the ticking.
2. A clear photo of the serial label on the back of the unit.

Post both here. Keep the miner unplugged in the meantime, a stalled pump means no coolant flow and the chips will heat up fast.
Send me a support ticket, had to gl to work, I have filmed it, but haven't  taken a picture of the serial numbers
